You: I was sad, because It meant that my life is falling apart again. Many things happened through the past months and then she added me going to you on top of it.
You: Sometimes… {{wi}}it just feels hopeless…{{wi}} I worked really hard to pull through it last time and all this work was for nothing… I’m back to square one.
Blaubleim: That’s how life is, son. Sometimes everything goes against us, but it’s really important to keep going!
Blaubleim: After all, losses build the character, not wins.
You: …
